assumptions.claim: The packer block must obey the FIFO write handshake: it must assert packer_wvalid only when packer_wready (i.e., fifo_wready) is high.
assumptions.risk: Violation leads to FIFO overflow or data loss.

assumptions.claim: The downstream consumer must obey the FIFO read handshake: it must assert msg_ready_i only when msg_valid_o is high.
assumptions.risk: Violation may cause FIFO underflow or corrupted data read.

assumptions.claim: clear_i must be a multi-bit encoded signal that can be strictly recognized as true by prim_mubi_pkg::mubi4_test_true_strict to assert the FIFO clear.
assumptions.cond: when a FIFO clear is required
assumptions.risk: If clear_i is stuck at a non-true encoding, the FIFO will never clear, potentially leaving secret data accessible.

assumptions.claim: MsgDepth must be set to a depth that accommodates the maximum message size to prevent FIFO overflow under normal operation.
assumptions.risk: FIFO overflow leading to data loss.

assumptions.claim: The prim_fifo_sync instance must correctly assert fifo_rvalid (high when not empty, low when empty) as per its specification.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect fifo_rvalid would cause wrong fifo_empty_o and msg_valid_o, leading to handshake violations or data loss.
